mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the permission matrix fact allows Customer to acquire PostDecision and GetAudit permissions, which the LeastPrivilege assertion explicitly forbids. This tests that the permission matrix is the load-bearing constraint for role-based access control.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermissionViolation { Customer -> PostDecision in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows decisions to exist without corresponding audit events, or with mismatched event types. This directly violates the append-only property, which requires every decision to be immutably recorded in the audit log.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditViolation { some dec: Decision, event: ApplicationEvent | dec.application = event.application and dec.decisionType = ApprovedDecision and event.eventType = RejectedEvent }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this constraint allows a customer to have multiple pending applications simultaneously, violating FR-005 which is critical to preventing the same customer from submitting duplicate loan requests while one is under review.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MultiplePending { some disj app1, app2: LoanApplication, customer: User | app1.customer = customer and app2.customer = customer and app1.status = PendingReview and app2.status = PendingReview }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows multiple decisions per application, directly violating the concurrent resolution constraint that only the first decision should be recorded (SC-005).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MultipleDecisions { some app: LoanApplication, disj dec1, dec2: Decision | dec1.application = app and dec2.application = app }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows applications to exist without submission audit events, breaking the audit completeness requirement (FR-016) that every status change must be recorded.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingSubmissionEvent { some app: LoanApplication | no event: ApplicationEvent | event.application = app and event.eventType = Submitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows customers to appear as decision makers, directly violating the role-based access control requirement (FR-015) that only bank staff can approve or reject applications.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CustomerCanDecide { some dec: Decision, customer: User | customer.role = Customer and dec.decidedByUser = customer }
